definition: Details of breakdown of a an amount or quantity.

LotNumber.name: Lot Number
LotNumber.definition: Identification, for tax purposes, of a lot of identical securities that are bought at a certain date and at a certain price.

LotAmount.name: Lot Amount
LotAmount.definition: Amount of money that is part of the lot described.

LotQuantity.name: Lot Quantity
LotQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instruments that is part of the lot described.

CashSubBalanceType.name: Cash Sub Balance Type
CashSubBalanceType.definition: Specifies the securities sub balance type indicator (example restriction type for a market infrastructure).
